data.summary: Install bundled agent skill files for chat-anywhere use

arguments.name: --agent
arguments.description: Which agent skill target to install; auto installs detected agents, or both when none are detected

notes: Uses the skill bundled with the installed package, falling back to the repo skill during editable development.
Existing skill directories are moved to timestamped backups before replacement.
This command only modifies Claude/Codex skill directories.
